papers.title: Unitary-invariant witnesses of quantum imaginarity
papers.identity_evidence: Inspected title/authors on PDFp1; footer arXiv2403.15066v1[quant-ph]22Mar2024; internal date25Mar2024. DOI metadata maps title/authors to PRL133190201(2024); this inspected file is preprintv1, not publisher VOR.
claims: Pp1-2: imaginary cyclic multivariate traces witness a set imaginary in every common basis; three-state pairwise overlaps insufficient.
P3 Theorem1 Gram PSD and Theorem2 third-order invariant region stated/read; complete appendix proofs not audited.
P4 Theorems4/5: Q3=R3 but R4 differs from Q4; no blanket claim that all four-plus-state pairwise overlaps are imaginarity-blind.
Conjugation sign ambiguity differs from existence of set imaginarity; no NLP utility, old-Q expressivity or quantum necessity follows.
limitations: Only pp1-4 read, appendix proofs not audited. No novelty clearance. Physical locality/resource assumptions do not automatically constrain an NLP simulator.
